svg.text: Sentinel Swarm ESP32 node: wiring diagram
Pin numbers from esp32_firmware.ino · ESP32 DevKit V1 (30-pin, DOIT layout) · labels like 3V3 / 5V / GND are power rails (see the power diagram)
Rows: outputs · Columns: inputs with pull-ups
It is the I2C clock (SCL) for the LCD and RTC, and the RFID reset pin.
The firmware switches it between the two (restoreI2cForLcd), so wire
all three to D22 exactly as shown.
